question: Which weather stations in Washington State recorded more than 150 rainy days in 2023 but fewer rainy days compared to 2022? Defining a “rainy day” as one having precipitation greater than zero millimeters and not equal to 99.99. Only include stations with valid precipitation data.
sql:
-- With valid precipitation data filter (exclude flag_prcp = 'I')
WITH wa_rainy_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
        g.stn,
        g.wban,
        COUNT(*) as rainy_days_2023
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
    WHERE g.stn != '999999'
        AND g.prcp > 0 
        AND g.prcp != 99.99
        AND g.flag_prcp != 'I'
    GROUP BY g.stn, g.wban
),
wa_rainy_2022 AS (
    SELECT 
        g.stn,
        g.wban,
        COUNT(*) as rainy_days_2022
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
    WHERE g.stn != '999999'
        AND g.prcp > 0 
        AND g.prcp != 99.99
        AND g.flag_prcp != 'I'
    GROUP BY g.stn, g.wban
),
wa_stations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT usaf, wban, name, state
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
    WHERE state = 'WA' AND usaf != '999999'
)
SELECT 
    w.name,
    w.state,
    COALESCE(r2023.rainy_days_2023, 0) as rainy_days_2023,
    COALESCE(r2022.rainy_days_2022, 0) as rainy_days_2022
FROM wa_stations w
LEFT JOIN wa_rainy_2023 r2023 ON w.usaf = r2023.stn AND w.wban = r2023.wban
LEFT JOIN wa_rainy_2022 r2022 ON w.usaf = r2022.stn AND w.wban = r2022.wban
WHERE COALESCE(r2023.rainy_days_2023, 0) > 150
    AND COALESCE(r2022.rainy_days_2022, 0) > COALESCE(r2023.rainy_days_2023, 0)
ORDER BY rainy_days_2023 DESC
